This facility has not published power consumption or IT capacity figures. The operator GoDaddy is known to run a 270,000 square foot data center in the Phoenix area, but this row is geocoded to Gilbert, a separate city roughly 20 to 25 miles away, and the two sites have not been confirmed to be the same location or distinct facilities.

Arizona has 56 mapped data center facilities, of which only 4 have published power specifications totaling 512 megawatts. This campus does not contribute a published figure to that total and therefore cannot be ranked by capacity within the state.

Without published specifications, this facility cannot be assessed for relevance to AI infrastructure scaling. If it is a distinct Gilbert location rather than the known Phoenix facility, it remains uncharacterized. Confirmation of its identity, power capacity, and cooling configuration would be required to determine whether it matters to AI compute deployment.
